text:
{"content":"The exception lookup misses moved all-day and floating-time occurrences. Assigning nativeTime creates a UTC date-time. Stored exception keys retain date-only or floating-time form. The lookup misses the exception, and the start-time fallback can return another occurrence before reporting occurrence-not-found.","codeSuggestion":"","assessment":"P2. Valid stored exceptions cannot load or save through this route.","rationale":"CalRecurrenceInfo.getRidKey preserves date-only and floating-time keys. getExceptionFor uses that key directly. The loader does not restore those properties before lookup. The Save tests cover UTC and named time zones but omit these moved exception forms.","recommendation":"change","validation":"Executed the current loader with actual Ical, CalDateTime, CalTimezone, CalDuration, CalRecurrenceDate, and CalRecurrenceInfo code. Event and calendar objects were controlled. All-day and floating-time cases returned occurrence-not-found. The UTC control loaded. Restoring the source date type and floating timezone found both exceptions. No Thunderbird runtime test ran.","appliedSummary":"Updated the [loader](/Users/aschmitz/projects/fox/comm/mail/components/calendar/content/calendar-event-source-loader.mjs:204) to preserve date-only and floating-time exception keys. The cloned search boundary uses a date-time so neighboring occurrences still load.

Added [tests](/Users/aschmitz/projects/fox/comm/mail/components/calendar/test/unit/test_calendarEventEditSave.js:807) for loading, Save, Undo, neighboring occurrences, and invalid IDs.

Lint, syntax, whitespace, and controlled checks passed. The xpcshell test remains unrun because available build source stamps are unknown. No exact accepted loader example was found; the diff follows the recorded evidence and documented boundary adjustment.

Changes remain unstaged and uncommitted.","changeSummary":"Restore the source date type and floating timezone before exception lookup. Preserve rejection of invalid recurrence IDs. Add moved all-day and floating-time exception tests.","state":"ready","changeAccepted":false,"changeReverted":false,"changesAmended":false}
